newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down, Central Bank sets trend.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down, Central Bank sets trend.

text.p: * Peso subdued by lower rates, dollar demand from power firm
The Philippine peso closed weaker on Thursday at its day-low of 26.255 to the dollar from 26.245 as banks took their cue from the Central Bank, traders said.
The easing of overnight interest rates and the surprise $32 million requirement of National Power Corp also pulled down the peso, they said.
The Central Bank widened its desired trading range, with bid and offer for the dollar at 26.225/26.255 from 26.23/26.25.
